rationale: Create one active Cyntox Biohazard Solutions platform under Igneo Infrastructure Partners. Igneo identifies Cyntox as the current manager-level asset formed from the completed acquisitions of Cyntox and AdvoWaste and records June 2026 entry and sole governance. AdvoWaste remains an operating brand and legal carrier beneath the combined platform, so task 307 must be superseded rather than creating a second PortCo. The exact holdco, fund, vehicle, ownership percentage and legal close day are not publicly disclosed, and no later ownership change or exit was identified through August 19, 2026.

afterImage.name: Cyntox Biohazard Solutions
afterImage.subsector: Regulated medical waste collection, transport, treatment, and disposal
afterImage.description: Cyntox Biohazard Solutions is a U.S. regulated medical-waste platform providing collection, transport, treatment, disposal and compliance services for sharps, pharmaceutical, pathological and other healthcare waste. The combined Cyntox and AdvoWaste operations serve thousands of physician offices, hospitals, ambulatory centers, dental and veterinary clinics, laboratories and long-term-care facilities across 26 states, with identified treatment facilities in Newton, New Jersey and Indianapolis. Igneo Infrastructure Partners completed the acquisitions in 2026, records June 2026 entry and sole governance, and lists Cyntox as the single manager-level asset. Cyntox LLC and AdvoWaste Medical Services LLC remain legal carriers and operating brands beneath the combined platform rather than separate PortCos. The exact holdco, fund, vehicle, equity percentage and legal close day are not publicly disclosed. No later add-on, owner change, exit or signed pending transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
